sop_thesis: **Dole (DOLE)** operates in Consumer Staples (Farming/Seeds/Milling) with an established market capitalization of $1.25B. The company maintains a confirmed Narrow Moat backed by Everyday Household Brand Trust, Shelf Space Dominance & Global Supply Scale. Long-term valuation metrics model an intrinsic DCF fair value of $15.82 (18.0% margin of safety). Systematic tranche entry is recommended at $13.14 (Tranche 1), $12.34 (Tranche 2), and $11.4 (Tranche 3).
